name: tree
title: File Tree
description: A file tree in a small bordered card, with chevrons on folders and file icons on the leaves. Rows highlight on selection, and folders expand in place to reveal their contents.
use: You need to browse a shallow hierarchy of folders and files with selection and expand.
avoid: It is a narrow column, and very deep nesting pushes indented rows past the right edge.
a11y: Rows are real buttons with aria-expanded and arrow key hotkeys; selection is also exposed, so the main gap is the missing reduced-motion check. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A compact card on black holds a vertical list of folders and files, each a single line with a small grey icon, one-step indentation per level and a chevron on folders. The selected row is a grey rounded bar and expanded folders push their children below them.
behaves: Clicking a row selects it with a grey fill; clicking a folder's chevron flips the arrow and opens or closes its children, shifting the rows underneath. The clip opens public, moves the selection between files and collapses components again.
customise: The tree takes an indent number and a tree instance from the headless library, while each row is an item wrapping a label; icons, names and selection styling are yours.
weight: light: A few dozen rows with colour transitions; state handling is in a small headless library.
demo: A small project tree with src, components, lib, public, Button.tsx, Card.tsx, logo.svg and package.json.
issues: Selected and hovered rows share the same accent fill, so the current file cannot be told apart from a hover.
polishWhy: Tidy aligned rows and clear icons, but the flat grey selection is ordinary.
